title: Computing and Learning Stationary Mean Field Equilibria with Low-Dimensional Interactions: Algorithms and Applications
abstract: arXiv:2502.12024v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mean field equilibrium (MFE) has emerged as a computationally tractable solution concept for large dynamic games. However, computing MFE remains challenging due to nonlinearities and the absence of contraction properties, limiting its reliability for counterfactual analysis and comparative statics. This paper studies dynamic models in which agents interact through a small number of functions of the population distribution, with particular emphasis on the scalar case. Such low-dimensional interactions naturally arise in a wide range of applications in economics and operations. The main contribution of this paper is to introduce iterative algorithms that leverage this structure and have provide global convergence guarantees for computing and learning MFE under mild assumptions. translated_title: 具有低维交互的平稳平均场均衡的计算与学习：算法与应用
translated_abstract: 平均场均衡（MFE）已成为大型动态博弈中一种计算上可处理的解概念。然而，由于非线性以及缺乏收缩性质，计算MFE仍然具有挑战性，这限制了其在反事实分析和比较静态分析中的可靠性。本文研究了这样一类动态模型：其中智能体通过少量关于总体分布的函数进行交互，并特别关注标量情形。这种低维交互在经济学和运营管理等广泛的应用场景中自然出现。本文的主要贡献是提出了利用这种结构的迭代算法，在温和的假设下为计算和学习MFE提供了全局收敛性保证。与现有方法不同，我们的算法不要求单调性或收缩性质。我们还提供了无模型算法来学习近似（原文截断）……
tldr: 本文提出利用低维交互结构的迭代算法，在无需单调性或收缩性质的温和假设下，为计算和学习平均场均衡提供了全局收敛性保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces iterative algorithms that leverage low-dimensional interaction structures, providing global convergence guarantees for computing and learning mean field equilibria under mild assumptions without requiring monotonicity or contraction properties.
